title: jmap-server: PushSubscription extension seam (using gate, required check_push_subscription_change hook, normalized echo)
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E1. Crates: jmap-server, jmap-chat-server. Size: M.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §4 ("To get or set the emailPush property, the client MUST include" the capability in using; default null), RFC 8620 §5.1 (invalid property => invalidArguments), §5.3 (echo server-changed values). Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §5.1, §6 (hook table), §9 item 0; decisions 1 and 9 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Work in crate-jmap-server/src/push.rs (+ parse.rs, lib.rs, tests/push_subscription_{get,set}.rs):
1. register_push_subscription_handlers closures pass cx.using to both handlers. Signature unchanged (decision 1).
2. New defaulted const PushSubscriptionBackend::PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENSION_CAPABILITIES: &[(property, capability URI)] = &[]. For a gated property P whose capability is not in using: /get strips P from every object, and P in `properties` => invalidArguments; /set create sending P, or a patch whose first segment is P => SetError invalidProperties [P], checked before the other validation. With the capability, an absent P is shown as null in /get and in `created`. chatPush stays ungated.
3. New REQUIRED (no default) hook check_push_subscription_change(caller, PushSubscriptionChange { old, new: &mut PushSubscription, changed: &BTreeSet<String> (create keys / patch first segments), using }) -> Result<(), BackendSetError<E>>. Called after the RFC 8620 checks and before create_/update_push_subscription. The call must live INSIDE handle_push_subscription_set (not a registration closure), so the conditional epic's opt-in re-registration of PushSubscription/set (decision 1) reuses it. Rustdoc: no side effects, same answer on every registration path.
4. created/updated echo every extra key whose value the hook changed, and do not echo unchanged keys.
5. parse::nests_deeper_than becomes pub filter_nests_deeper_than(&Value, usize); MAX_FILTER_DEPTH becomes pub.
6. jmap-chat-server memory: move validate_chat_push from create/update into the hook (behaviour unchanged). The 2 test mocks implement the hook.
BREAKING for PushSubscriptionBackend implementors: CHANGELOG entry and public-api snapshot refresh for jmap-server and jmap-chat-server.
Acceptance: jmap-server tests with a mock gating emailPush — without the capability /get strips it, properties:["emailPush"] => invalidArguments, a create or an emailPush/A patch => invalidProperties ["emailPush"]; with it, an absent emailPush is null in /get and created; the hook sees `changed` exactly; the hook's SetError reaches notCreated/notUpdated; a normalized key is echoed in created/updated and an unchanged one is not; chat-server tests pass unchanged. Must land before the conditional epic's PushSubscription bead (docs/design/conditional.md §11).
